senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; עוּט to swing) bird of prey.
units: Pirké d’R. El. ch. XXVIII. ואין הע׳ אלא בן דוד שנמשל לע׳ the ʿayiṭ (Gen. XV, 11) is typical of the son of David who is compared to a bird of prey.

<cite ref="Genesis 15:11">Ib.</cite> <he>כדי שלא ימשול בהם הע׳ וכ׳</he> that the bird of prey might not have control of them until evening; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 76">Yalk. Gen. 76</cite>; a. e.
